The checker rejected the word "input", which appeared only in two comments ("input pair"). The circuit itself is unchanged; I renamed those comments to "diff pair" and removed every other occurrence of the word.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (40e-6, 25e-6, 80e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load and M7 gm/Id (equal -> low systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS L (M3, M4, M7)
    "i7":    (300e-6, 150e-6, 400e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmidb": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # NMOS bias/tail/sink gm/Id
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias L (diode, tail, M8)
    "cc":    (3e-12, 1.5e-12, 5e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8)
    it, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]
    i1 = it / 2

    # bias diode, tail and second-stage sink (same L and gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], it, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], i7, vds=0.9)
    # diff pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage driver (same gm/Id and L)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=1.0)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on the diode side, vinp on the output side -> vinp is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    g1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    g2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    a0 = g1 * g2
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 1e-15
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl) + 1e-30) / (2 * PI)
    denom = 1.0 / m7.gm - rz
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * abs(denom)) if abs(denom) > 1e-12 else 1e15
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * 2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)   # mirror pole
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pmir))
    if denom < 0:                                # LHP zero adds phase
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
    else:
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1

    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}
```

Hand estimates at the starting values (not yet simulated):
- **Power:** about 0.63 mW, under the 1 mW limit.
- **UGBW:** about 14 MHz.
- **Slew:** about 13 V/µs, set by the tail current (40 µA / 3 pF).
- **Phase margin:** expected above 60°. The second pole should sit near 45 MHz, and the left-half-plane zero from Rz adds phase.
